assertionResults.title: Empty state

steps.observed: Authenticated delivery log page loaded after manual navigation from /dashboard

steps.expected: A clear empty-state message with guidance such as 'No email deliveries found. Adjust filters to see more results.' is visible
steps.observed: Only the filter toolbar rendered; no empty-state message, table body, or recovery guidance was visible

steps.expected: Out-of-range page shows empty-state guidance and pagination recovery controls
steps.observed: Page showed 'Showing 0-0 of 0 results' and 'Page 999' with Prev/Next controls, but no explanatory empty-state text or recovery guidance. Prev decremented URL to page=998 rather than resetting to a valid page.

network: GET /api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&range=7d&page=1&pageSize=50 -> request captured for zero-result run
GET /api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&range=7d&page=999&pageSize=50 -> request captured for out-of-range run
GET /api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&range=7d&page=998&pageSize=50 -> request captured after clicking Prev

assertionResults.issues: Empty-state guidance text was absent in both deterministic zero-result and out-of-range states; out-of-range pagination also lacked a visible recovery shortcut to a valid page.

assertionResults.title: Error state

steps.expected: A visible error alert/message and retry affordance render when the API errors
steps.observed: The page remained on the standard filter toolbar with no visible alert, no error copy, and no retry button/affordance

steps.action: Inspect network and console after forced-error load
steps.expected: The UI should surface the API error while request/console evidence reflects the failure
steps.observed: GET /api/ops/email-delivery?...simulateEmailDeliveryError=1&messageId=__force_error__ requests were captured repeatedly and the console reported 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 418 (I'm a Teapot)', but no user-facing error UI appeared.

consoleErrors: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 418 (I'm a Teapot)
Hydration mismatch error logged on the page during rerun

assertionResults.issues: Canonical forced-error trigger produces backend failure evidence, but no visible alert/message or retry affordance renders in the delivery log UI.

frictions.description: Successful sign-in redirected to /dashboard instead of keeping the validator on /email-delivery.
frictions.resolution: Navigated directly back to /email-delivery after authentication as instructed.

summary: Re-ran 2 authenticated delivery-log assertions. Both failed: VAL-DL-014 lacked visible empty-state guidance in zero-result and out-of-range states, and VAL-DL-017 showed backend 418 failures without any user-facing error alert or retry affordance.
